text: Governance is built. Now Power BI connects to exactly one table, claims_summary_gold, and that choice is load-bearing, not incidental.
Import mode, since gold refreshes nightly. No relationship to claims_detail_gold anywhere in the model -- the dashboard can't become a side door around the clinic filters.
Every measure is a plain aggregation of a column gold already computed -- nothing re-derives billed or denied logic from row-level data this report never sees.
Validated Clinic 04's post-backfill July total against a direct query before publishing, and the service principal has no grant on claims_detail_gold at all.
The model's safe and live. Next: showing Compliance and Clinical Quality the real access controls -- and a real bug -- in person.
